name: Rook Reflex
description: Deterministic Reflex Router, latency telemetry, and undelivered-run recorder for Rook.

enabled.description: Master switch. false = hooks registered but inert.

hintOnDirect.description: Emit the one-line route-A hint. false = stay silent on route A.

maxHintChars.description: Hard cap on the prependContext routing hint.

directChannels.description: Channels treated as direct human chats.

includeChannellessRuns.description: Route CLI/gateway runs that carry no channel (openclaw agent --session-key ...).

undeliveredChannels.description: Channels where a run with >=1 tool call and no message_sent is recorded as an undelivered/silent run. CLI and webchat one-shots are excluded on purpose.

longPromptChars.description: Prompt length above which route B is forced.

longDocChars.description: Attached-document length above which route B is forced.

maxDistinctAsks.description: More distinct asks than this forces route B.

longMediaSeconds.description: Media longer than this forces route B.
